title: review
description: The structured result a reviewing role ends its answer with. The enums mirror supervisor/_vendor/contract.py REVIEW_VERDICTS and FINDING_CATEGORIES, and the two conditional blocks below encode the cross-field rules enforced by contract.review_result(): an ACCEPT may carry no blocking finding, and an advisory finding may only block when the verdict is BLOCKED. A review judges the frozen inputs it was given, never the producer's self-assessment.

verdict.description: ACCEPT = meets the requirements as delivered. REVISE = fixable within the same approach. REJECT = the approach itself is wrong. BLOCKED = the review could not be completed (missing inputs, no tools, interrupted); an interruption is not a finding.

findings.description: One entry per concrete problem. Empty on a clean ACCEPT and on BLOCKED.

summary.description: What was reviewed and the reasoning behind the verdict.

reviewed.description: The frozen inputs this verdict applies to. If they change the review is INVALIDATED and re-queued.

digest.description: Artifact digest the verdict is bound to, when the packet supplied one.

permission_denials.description: Added by the adapter, not by the reviewer.

category.description: correctness = wrong behaviour. requirement = an acceptance criterion is unmet. regression = previously working behaviour broke. architecture = violates an agreed interface or boundary. quality = readable/maintainable concern. advisory = optional improvement, never blocking.

blocking.description: true means the delivery cannot be accepted until this is addressed.

message.description: The problem and what would resolve it.

evidence.description: Where it is: file:line, a test name and its output, or a quoted requirement. A finding without evidence is not a finding.
